description:
Hushfeed v0.66.0 has 102 patches for global TikTok 47.0.3, 47.1.3 and 47.1.4 (`com.zhiliaoapp.musically`). It needs Morphe Manager 1.32.0 or newer.

## What's changed

* TikTok 47.1.4 is supported now, beside 47.0.3 and 47.1.3 (#56). Every patch applies to each of the three.
* Hushfeed's settings come in Italian (#61) and Russian (#60). They're first passes, so if a label reads oddly, please open an issue and say which one.
* Change app name is a new patch that puts a name you pick under the app icon and in Android's app list (#59). Type the name in the patch's options in Morphe Manager.
* Keep a streak going, also new, sends one message a day to someone you pick, at a time you pick. Set it up under Hushfeed settings > Inbox > Streak.
* For a follow or a like that undoes itself on a patched build, try the new Look like the store app patch (#55). It's off by default. Turn it on under Hushfeed settings > Privacy and restart TikTok.
* With the new Keep playing in the background patch, a video keeps going after you leave TikTok or turn the screen off (#52).
* The share sheet no longer shows "Tap again to send" on a friend you never touched (#58). You can also add apps of your own to its Share via row.
* Fit the video to the screen fits a video again when the space around it changes size (#29).
* Two new switches: Let the last video finish on the Screen time page, and Hide effect and template tags on the Feed screen page (#51).
* Patching is faster (#54), and Stop on-device AI profiling works again.
* The diagnostic report has FEED MUTE and VIDEO FIT sections, so a report of a silent feed or a badly fitted video shows what Hushfeed did.

See the [changelog](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushFeed/blob/v0.66.0/CHANGELOG.md) for the full list.

## Checked

* 2565 runtime tests and 480 patch tests passed. Both Android lint checks passed.
* All 102 patches applied to all three supported APKs. Resource checks passed. The manifest gains three permissions, all from Keep a streak going and only when it's selected: start at boot and two for exact alarms. The attached release receipt records the exact bundle and each target's result.
* On an Android emulator running TikTok 47.1.3, Keep a streak going's message arrived from its alarm while TikTok was closed, and again when TikTok was opened after a missed time. On a phone, patching the recommended set in Morphe Manager took about 6 1/2 minutes, down from 8 3/4.

## Install

Use Morphe Manager 1.32.0 or newer. An older Manager says the bundle needs a Manager update. Refresh the Hushfeed source, select the TikTok 47.0.3, 47.1.3 or 47.1.4 APK, then patch and install it. Keep the manager's existing signing key when updating.

`patches-0.66.0.mpp` is the patch bundle, not a TikTok APK. `SHA256SUMS.txt` includes checksums for the bundle and its release receipt.
